_comment: Knights guild layer for 3s. Bars: Stamina (STM, gp1), Strain (STN, gp2 - a % where HIGH is bad), Mount (the mount's stamina, MST / GMCP mount_stamina). Fed by katmud_lib/knight.py from the three-line prompt, gs (Morale) and GMCP Guild.State; the status line shows stance + method, Prepared (UNPREPARED in capitals - 'prepare on' after gearing up), Battlecry when up, Second Wind %, Morale, last fight's rounds and the mount. MIP/FFF is gone mud-side (2026-09-15). Cascade rule REPLACE (character file wins).
BA on the prompt is not decoded (meaning unknown). Strain warnings (amber 50%, red 80%) are a guess - tune them.

Attack: requires an explicit target ('kill <mob>'); plain 'kill' won't work. autoattack_command left empty so Hunt parses the room and sends 'kill <keyword>'. Charge is a separate combat method (higher glvl + a quest), not an attack command.
